title: Extremal non-Hamiltonian graphs at one more than the critical edge count
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $
u \ge 3$ vertices that is not Hamiltonian and has exactly $ inom{
u-1}{2}+1$ edges. Then $G$ is isomorphic to $C_{1,
u}$, unless $
u = 5$, in which case $G$ is isomorphic to either $C_{1,5}$ or $C_{2,5}$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
